rejected_headline_claims: Only Chio can express receiver-owned authority.
Paid child independence or partitioned resource conservation alone is new.
Local remedy planning or a signed unknown outcome alone is new.
A peer-to-peer kernel can reconstruct opaque effects or enforce plaintext secrecy against an authorized malicious recipient.
A unified security-kernel architecture or multiple policy authorities alone establishes novelty.

claims.statement: A reusable contract for edges between independently owned kernels composes exact authority, knowledge restrictions, resource exposure and backed obligations through partial effects and recovery, with a nontrivial sufficiency argument and less repeated correctness machinery than the strongest matched construction.
assumptions: PR #1172 revision 3 P0-P6 semantics hold under their declared profiles, by the user-supplied shipped assumption.
Honest-owner qualified mediation, authentic keys, protected durable state and specified revocation boundaries; a remote receipt is evidence, not live local authority.
Each affected owner authorizes a recipient host for continued restriction enforcement or authorizes the disclosure; no guarantee against an authorized malicious recipient leaking plaintext.
Matched non-equivocating settlement, checker trust, independent child backing, provider observations and resource budgets in Chio and B1-B3.

Observable settlement facts, including payment occurrence, amount, beneficiary, exposed timing and acceptance-token existence, require affected-owner authorization for their actual observers (including S/V), or an equally provisioned qualified confidential settlement profile. The positive walkthrough permits its limited commercial metadata; this does not approve disclosure of issue content.
Finite acyclic work graph, one unresolved effectful continuation per local workflow, one outbound effect submission in the initial E1/E2 profiles.
Conditional progress requires available dependencies and fair scheduling; E2 unknown effects need not become knowable.

observable_difference.behavior: K1-K7 on the identical work graph and observations, including useful F01/F06/F09 paths; equal traces are allowed to refute behavioral exclusivity.
observable_difference.composition: Which local assumptions and edge obligations suffice for K5; number and nature of task-specific correctness obligations outside the reusable interface, recorded for both systems.
observable_difference.cost: Trusted domains, required coordination, retained state and repeated integration/recovery work; every shared baseline library and Chio adapter is counted symmetrically.
observable_difference.importance: Independent participants could accept consequential delegated work with a stable correctness boundary rather than designing fresh failure and disclosure protocols for each workflow.

falsifier: A counterexample violates K5 under the declared honest-owner premises.
The contract merely restates existing compositional interfaces and supplies no nontrivial theorem, algorithm or consequential systems tradeoff.
A reusable B1/B2/B3 construction achieves equal guarantees and comparable trust, coordination and repeated integration cost.

next_test.first_probe: F04/F05/F07/F08/F09/F10/F12/F13, with F01/F06 positive controls. Formulate J1-J4 against B1 before any prototype.
next_test.gate: Task 3 G1 must produce a surviving nontrivial result candidate or preregistered consequential systems tradeoff; otherwise narrow or reject.

counterdesign.controller: Finite registered remedies plus established observation-based state tracking; local authority and original effect identities retained.

observable_difference.behavior: Safely enabled action sets under identical observation prefixes, especially E1 reconciliation, E2 uncertainty and independent workflow progress.
observable_difference.cost: Controller state, evidence queries, inter-owner coordination, decision time and declared completeness bounds.

next_test.gate: No independent R2 headline unless G1 identifies an actual procedure and surviving advantage; equal behavior remains a valid negative result.

claims.statement: The kernel/recovery interface materially reduces repeated integration and operational repair for independent work families while preserving matched safety, quality and recovery guarantees.
assumptions: PR #1172 revision 3 P0-P6 semantics hold under their declared profiles, by the user-supplied shipped assumption.
Honest-owner qualified mediation, authentic keys, protected durable state and specified revocation boundaries; a remote receipt is evidence, not live local authority.
Each affected owner authorizes a recipient host for continued restriction enforcement or authorizes the disclosure; no guarantee against an authorized malicious recipient leaking plaintext.
Matched non-equivocating settlement, checker trust, independent child backing, provider observations and resource budgets in Chio and B1-B3.

Conditional progress requires available dependencies and fair scheduling; E2 unknown effects need not become knowable.
Independent teams, matched assistance and an improvement period for baseline shared libraries are required for comparative productivity claims.

observable_difference.behavior: Equivalent required safety, useful completions and accepted work quality across the support/public-issue and confined-research families.
observable_difference.cost: Initial build separately from repeated hands-on integration/setup and recovery; record assistance, bespoke repair, trusted adapter changes and incidents.
observable_difference.importance: A credible common kernel removes repeated application-specific correctness work rather than relocating it into hidden adapters.

falsifier: A competent reusable baseline has comparable effort and recovery outcomes.
Reported gains disappear when assistance, shared-library amortization, adapter work, capital, security coverage and quality are matched.
The claim depends on code-line counts, a single author demonstration, or treating locally operated participants as independent.

next_test.first_probe: If model work does not reveal a new mechanism, preregister one consequential systems tradeoff before authorizing Task 4; reserve productivity conclusions for Task 6 independent exercises.
next_test.gate: No substitution of a narrower result for the flagship thesis without explicit scope discussion. No external partner yet and no outreach authorized.
